releaseCandidateStatement: This is the Phase 2.7.1 SOFTWARE RELEASE CANDIDATE for Windows x64 (Content Intelligence Operationalization & Church Resource Library UX). It is a real, verifiable build artifact - not a placeholder, not a simulation, not a fabrication. See docs/phase-2-7-1-content-operationalization.md for the full PASS/HOLD breakdown and final gate.
physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. This installer has not been installed, launched, or tested on any real Windows machine. No real microphone, no real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, and no real human operator workflow has been exercised against this build. Xvfb, simulated audio, virtual displays, automated tests, and cross-compilation success are Environment A/B evidence only and are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation.
githubReleaseStatus: NOT CONFIGURED - no .github/workflows directory exists in this repository, and no GitHub Release has been created for this artifact. This installer is available only via this repository's working tree (release/windows/), not via GitHub Releases or any CI/CD pipeline.
obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there. Running the installer on Windows requires none of: Claude Code, Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, or the CIP source tree - only the .exe file itself.
